result.summary: The street provides basic pedestrian infrastructure with sidewalks on both sides, but the environment is degraded by debris and a lack of traffic control markings. The presence of blank frontages and industrial fencing creates an isolated atmosphere with poor natural surveillance.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Debris and trash are scattered across the left sidewalk, creating potential tripping hazards and narrowing the usable path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at the visible intersection increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the distance

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: Long stretches of windowless walls and fencing reduce natural surveillance, potentially impacting pedestrian security.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Implement regular street cleaning to remove debris and maintain a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting buffer to provide physical separation from the roadway and improve the walking environment.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a roadway with no physical buffer. The street edge is defined by a long metal fence bordering a grassy area, creating a significant stretch of blank frontage that lacks active surveillance.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the travel lane, exposing pedestrians to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the foreground.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The long fence and lack of active land use may lead to higher vehicle speeds and a reduced sense of security for pedestrians due to lack of activity.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center background behind the fence.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If this is a long block, consider a mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and curb extensions to improve connectivity and slow traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an excessively wide roadway with minimal markings and a lack of dedicated crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk exists on the left side, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput and lacks basic safety features like marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide without any pedestrian refuge, exposing pedestrians to traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground across the main asphalt expanse

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway width in the foreground

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The sidewalk is only present on one side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or cross unprotected to reach destinations.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the excessive width of the travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds and reclaim space for wider sidewalks or bike lanes.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a curved urban roadway with a narrow, cracked sidewalk separated from a lower-level area by a metal fence. A damaged guardrail and accumulated debris create physical hazards for pedestrians in an environment that lacks lighting and traffic calming.

hazards.name: Damaged Guardrail
hazards.description: A metal guardrail is bent and protruding into the pedestrian walkway area.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center foreground, along the curb line

hazards.name: Debris and Trash
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and debris along the fence line create tripping hazards and narrow the usable walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk against the fence

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which would make this curved section dangerous for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible streetscape

interventions.title: Guardrail Repair and Realignment
interventions.description: Repair or replace the damaged guardrail and ensure it is positioned to protect pedestrians without obstructing the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers, especially given the roadway curvature.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Remove debris and repair cracks in the sidewalk surface to provide a clear, stable walking path.
